Rank plot of invented vaccines, with licensed vaccines for comparison

plot_vaccine_ranks.Rd

Exhaustive vaccines ranked by the IPD they leave (rank 1 = lowest IPD): the best n_top, then n_sample ranks evenly spread over the rest. Vaccines from other_methods are placed at the rank they would have among the exhaustive vaccines. Licensed vaccines are dashed horizontal lines.

Usage

plot_vaccine_ranks(
  vaccine_data,
  known_ipd,
  n_top = 100,
  n_sample = 1000,
  other_methods = "greedy",
  method_labels = character(0),
  ipd_scale = 1e+05,
  ipd_label = "IPD per 100,000"
)

Arguments

vaccine_data

Invented vaccines, e.g. from design_vaccines().

known_ipd

Named numeric vector: IPD score per licensed vaccine.

n_top

Number of best exhaustive vaccines shown individually.

n_sample

Number of evenly spaced ranks shown from the remaining ones.

other_methods

Methods placed among the exhaustive ranks.

method_labels

Named character vector: display name per method.

ipd_scale

IPD is multiplied by this for display.

ipd_label

y-axis label. Keep in step with ipd_scale.

Value

A ggplot.
